title: Seagull agent and platform compatibility window

rules.absent_server_descriptor: treated as protocol 1, negotiation marked degraded
rules.unsupported_protocol_version: server answers HTTP 426 and the agent stops retrying that operation
rules.unsupported_response_action: agent answers with status failed and an unsupported_action_type error
rules.unexpected_response_action_status: agent rejects the action before execution and reports an invalid response action
rules.privileged_action_on_sensor_profile: agent refuses locally regardless of server intent
rules.write_ahead_delivery: batches are persisted before delivery whenever the durable queue is available; direct delivery is attempted only after queue persistence fails
rules.durable_delivery_acknowledgement: required before the agent removes a persisted batch
rules.legacy_delivery_acknowledgement: rejected because durable acceptance must be explicit
rules.duplicate_batch_in_flight: retryable and never acknowledged as durable
